contact.basis: Source ground at the center of the four legs. Individual concrete plinths have approximate original-field contacts.

verticalDatum: Official GSI elevation-tile heights; host-relative visualization. No local survey datum transformation or accuracy claim.

sourceSelection.method: First layer with all four valid interpolation pixels. NoData is never interpreted as zero or filled across gaps.

attribution: 国土地理院 地理院タイル (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan)
method: Original official RGB24 signed-centimetre tiles bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in the signed model frame. The 256 m park context grid retains independent heights without flattening or fitting the building. Original source tile bytes are retained.
limitations: Tile pixel spacing and centimetre encoding are not survey accuracy. GSI tiles are interpolated elevation products.
The field represents current GSI source conditions and may differ locally from the 2011 park surface. Other host terrain remains host-dependent.
